crossRefs.note: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains, for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will…
Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come…
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…

translations.web: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.
translations.bsb: All the earth is at peace and at rest; they break out in song.
translations.kjv: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
translations.asv: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
